verdict.rationale: Solid is documented as built on TypeScript (solid-gh-15) and provides a tsconfig setup that points JSX typing at its own types via "jsxImportSource": "solid-js" (solid-gh-17). That is the framework's own hook into the standard TypeScript language service for JSX type-checking. Nothing in the pack describes editor autocompletion, inline type errors, or a dedicated language-service or editor plugin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editor autocompletion and inline type-error behavior, any dedicated language service or editor extension, and hands-on or independent corroboration of type accuracy in editors.
